from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    # The repeated singleton color marks the centers of the stamps.
    singleton_counts = Counter()
    seen = set()
    for r,c in cells:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while q:
            y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if p in cells and p not in seen:
                    seen.add(p); q.append(p)
        if len(comp)==1:
            singleton_counts[grid[r][c]] += 1
    marker = max(singleton_counts, key=singleton_counts.get)
    marks = [(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] == marker]
    pattern = {(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] != marker}
    minr=min(r for r,c in pattern); maxr=max(r for r,c in pattern)
    minc=min(c for r,c in pattern); maxc=max(c for r,c in pattern)
    cr=(minr+maxr)//2; cc=(minc+maxc)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar,ac in marks:
        for r,c in pattern:
            rr=ar+(r-cr); col=ac+(c-cc)
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= col < w:
                out[rr][col]=grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-ff293dc5.py'; path.write_text(code)
